task: Desktop browser finding B1: direct model-facing CDP/console output and screenshot attachments

patch.applyCheck: git apply --check --ignore-space-change succeeds current root; preserve all B4 shutdown/constructor and other integrated changes, do not copy whole Host/Bridge files
patch.dependencies: New BrowserToolResult pure QtCore/QtGui helper is picked up by BROWSER_SOURCES glob; no new runtime/library dependency. Test uses ade_ui for SessionStore plus QtTest and existing worker/WebView loader. Windows platform is required, with hidden fixture windows.

sourceContract.behavior: Browser CDP is sandbox-only upstream, except readConsoleLogs. Native direct browser tools are an existing extension, retained here.
Screenshot workflow captures raw API.sendCDP data, Buffer.from base64, API.createAttachment, then injects att image on next model step.

capToolOutput defaults to40*1024 JSON UTF8 bytes; string truncation respects UTF8. Native direct outputs are serialized text, so this slice caps that string with transparent suffix, not a claim of identical typed-object/array truncation.
Console tool result is capped upstream.

implementation: BrowserToolBridge raw completed responses and sandbox API.sendCDP retain the existing2*1024*1024 UTF16-code-unit transport bound; that existing check is not2MiB of UTF8 bytes.

AgentToolHost tracks only directly dispatched Page.captureScreenshot opaque request IDs. Successful raw PNG/JPEG/WebP screenshots are strictly base64-decoded, type/dimensions/full-decode checked, stored through existing per-agent AttachmentStore, captured into immutable pathReferences/pathMetadata, and completed via completeExternalToolWithAttachments.

Direct screenshot history retains a short acknowledgment and owned att reference. Existing provider-aware AttachmentPipeline supplies image parts transiently for supported models. Stored original bytes equal the actual CDP response; no base64 screenshot text is persisted.

Direct getBrowserTabs/sendCDP/readConsoleLogs text is capped to40KiB measured as JSON-encoded UTF8 string including escaping and Engine error prefix, with explicit truncation/narrower-query/sandbox guidance. Small text remains exact apart from existing secret redaction semantics.

Redaction occurs before slicing to avoid exposing a partial configured secret, and limit calculation accounts for Engine recordToolResult redacting again. Synthetic short-key expansion is tested; no Engine or credential-loading changes.

attachmentCreated publishes a virtual owned path, then lifetime/engine/original opaque token is rechecked before settlement. Cancel/replacement or Host/Engine deletion cannot attach the old result to replacement work.
Definitions now describe image attachments for direct screenshots and distinguish direct model cap from raw sandbox transport.

remainingLimits: Only direct Page.captureScreenshot is classified as an image result. Other CDP methods returning arbitrary binary/base64 stay bounded text; use the documented sandbox attachment workflow for those.
Truncated direct raw JSON is intentionally text with a visible suffix and may no longer be parseable JSON. Raw API.sendCDP remains available to code needing complete structure.
Actual screenshot transport fixture exercised PNG. JPEG/WebP share validated decoder paths but were not independently exercised against this WebView runtime.
Existing raw transport ceiling may reject large screenshots before Host conversion; no high-DPI capture fallback or screenshot compression strategy was added.

Image validation keeps the existing64M-pixel native decode ceiling. Per-model resizing/format/request caps remain AttachmentPipeline policy; declared vision capability is not live provider entitlement.
A failure or cancellation after writing but before publication can leave an unreferenced owned blob/snapshot under existing file-context cleanup; no false history authority is granted.
Canonical result and UI display metadata may each retain capped text;40KiB is the final model tool-content limit, not a total-session byte limit.
No B2 tab ownership, B3 hidden-tab startup, B4 shared event subscriptions, or other browser-review scope implemented by this slice.
